_comment: How characters who SHARE a rig are told apart. Read by ToonCastVariation during story repair; the binary carries clamped _fallback_only copies. This exists because good casting created a new problem: once three roles all correctly resolved to one Pig rig, the film went out with identical triplets. Story-agnostic on purpose — three brothers, two children lost in a wood, five villagers, same rule.
_clothingTokens_comment: Only tokens the rig ACTUALLY declares are recoloured, and only clothing. Recolouring `skin` would turn a sibling into a different species — a worse failure than the sameness being fixed. A rig with no clothing token is left alone and differs by height only.
_swatches_comment: The FIRST character in a group keeps the rig's authored palette — that is the one the artist tuned, and every character being a deviation from a version nobody sees is its own kind of wrong. These are for the second onward.
_scaleLadder_comment: A small height ladder in first-appearance order, which reads as older-to-younger siblings and survives being seen in silhouette. Deliberately shallow: 0.88 is a shorter brother, not a child standing next to an adult.
